description: Antigravity (agy) as a bare stateless engine node — `r4t engine agy run`, one headless turn per wake with no roster or dispatcher; STATUS.md/LESSONS.md in the node's own root are its only memory. Pick a model with `a8s vars <name> set MODEL <id>` (or `a8s add ... --model=<id>`); unset means the engine's own default. Tune it with --permissions on the invoke lines below; `r4t engine agy check` proves the argv still parses.
